teatro_colon.name: Teatro Colón
teatro_colon.price_text: Guided tours roughly ARS 30,000–60,000; check current price at the box office
teatro_colon.hours: Tours daily, usually 09:00–17:00; check on the day
teatro_colon.tip: Book a guided tour in advance and try for a cheap standing ticket to an evening concert.
teatro_colon.best: Morning tour; evening for a performance

casa_rosada.name: Casa Rosada
casa_rosada.price_text: Free; guided visits need online booking
casa_rosada.hours: Guided visits on set days, usually weekends; check on the day
casa_rosada.tip: Free tours fill fast, so register on the official site a few days ahead.

recoleta_cemetery.name: Recoleta Cemetery
recoleta_cemetery.price_text: Free entry; small fee for some guided tours
recoleta_cemetery.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00; check on the day
recoleta_cemetery.tip: Pick up a free map at the gate and look for Evita's family vault.

obelisco.name: Obelisco de Buenos Aires
obelisco.tip: Come at night for the lights, and keep an eye on your phone and bag in the crowd.

plaza_de_mayo.name: Plaza de Mayo
plaza_de_mayo.tip: Walk the square on a Thursday afternoon to see the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo march.
plaza_de_mayo.best: Daytime; Thursday afternoon for the march

caminito.name: Caminito
caminito.price_text: Free to walk; paid photos with tango dancers
caminito.hours: Street always open; shops and stalls daytime
caminito.tip: Go in daylight and stay on the busy main streets; skip it after dark.

ateneo.name: El Ateneo Grand Splendid
ateneo.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–21:00; check on the day
ateneo.tip: Go up to the stage-side café for a coffee and a view over the old theatre.

malba.name: MALBA
malba.price_text: Paid entry, roughly ARS 15,000–30,000; check on the day
malba.hours: Closed Tuesday; usually 12:00–20:00; check on the day
malba.tip: See the Latin American collection, then sit in the café in Palermo's green edge.

puente_mujer.name: Puente de la Mujer
puente_mujer.tip: Walk over at sunset and stay for dinner in Puerto Madero.

bombonera.name: La Bombonera
bombonera.price_text: Museum and stadium tour paid; match tickets vary widely
bombonera.hours: Museum tours on non-match days; check on the day
bombonera.tip: Book a stadium tour rather than a match if you want a calm visit.

asado.name: Asado dinner
asado.price_text: Roughly ARS 25,000–60,000 per person with wine; check on the day
asado.hours: Most parrillas open for lunch and from about 20:00 for dinner
asado.tip: Order a mixed grill to share and go easy on the bread so you have room for the meat.

biblioteca_nacional.name: Biblioteca Nacional Mariano Moreno
biblioteca_nacional.hours: Weekdays roughly 09:00–21:00; check on the day
biblioteca_nacional.tip: Step inside for the striking concrete reading rooms, then walk through the park behind.

cabildo.name: Cabildo of Buenos Aires
cabildo.hours: Closed some weekdays; usually 10:00–18:00; check on the day
cabildo.tip: Combine it with Plaza de Mayo and the Casa Rosada in one walk.

libertadores.name: Estadio Libertadores de América
libertadores.price_text: Tour price varies; check on the day
libertadores.hours: Tours on non-match days; check on the day
libertadores.tip: Only worth the trip south if you are a football fan; check tour times first.

monumental.name: Estadio Monumental
monumental.price_text: Tour price varies; check on the day
monumental.hours: Tours on non-match days; check on the day
monumental.tip: It sits far north in Núñez, so allow extra time to get there.

presidente_peron.name: Estadio Presidente Perón
presidente_peron.price_text: Tour price varies; check on the day
presidente_peron.hours: Tours on non-match days; check on the day
presidente_peron.tip: This is Racing's ground in Avellaneda, across the river; check transport and tour times.

floralis.name: Floralis Genérica
floralis.hours: Park always open; the flower opens and closes with daylight
floralis.tip: Come near sunset to see the steel petals close.

kavanagh.name: Kavanagh Building
kavanagh.tip: View it from Plaza San Martín across the street for the best angle.

la_boca.name: La Boca
la_boca.tip: Stay in the tourist streets near Caminito and take a taxi back.

rio_plata.name: La Plata River
rio_plata.tip: Walk the Puerto Madero waterfront for river views and the bird reserve.

congreso.name: National Congress of Argentina
congreso.hours: Guided visits on set days; check on the day
congreso.tip: Book a free guided visit online and look up at the green dome from the plaza.

bellas_artes.name: National Museum of Fine Arts
bellas_artes.hours: Closed Monday; usually 11:00–19:00; check on the day
bellas_artes.tip: Free entry and a strong Argentine collection; go on a weekday to avoid crowds.

san_telmo_market.name: San Telmo Market
san_telmo_market.price_text: Free to enter; food roughly ARS 8,000–20,000
san_telmo_market.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–20:00; Sunday fair fills the streets
san_telmo_market.tip: Come hungry on a Sunday and combine it with the street fair.

palermo_walk.name: Palermo Soho and Hollywood walk
palermo_walk.tip: Wander the tree-lined streets for shops and cafés, then stay for dinner.

tango_show.name: Tango dinner show
tango_show.price_text: Roughly ARS 40,000–120,000 with dinner; check on the day
tango_show.tip: Book ahead and confirm whether dinner and transfers are included.

puerto_madero_reserve.name: Ecological Reserve, Puerto Madero
puerto_madero_reserve.tip: Rent a bike or walk the paths for river views and birds.

recoleta_walk.name: Recoleta and Plaza Francia walk
recoleta_walk.hours: Daytime; weekend craft fair on the plaza
recoleta_walk.tip: Combine the cemetery, the fine arts museum and the weekend craft fair in one loop.

mate_cafe.name: Café and mate stop
mate_cafe.price_text: Coffee roughly ARS 3,000–6,000; check on the day
mate_cafe.hours: Most cafés open early to late
mate_cafe.tip: Try a cortado and a medialuna for a classic local breakfast.
